2024-10-30
Claim received for a sideswipe that occurred while the insured was changing lanes. The claimant is represented by
counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
2024-12-04
Reviewed the pohtos submitted with the first notice. They confirm several details of the reported impact, but there are
no independent witnesses to the collision itself. The vehicle damage is consistent with the described impact, and no
prior damage to the vehicle is known from the file or the carrier's records.
2025-01-26
Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that nothing in the file suggests the damage happened before
coverage began. The claimant has described the seating position at the time of impact, but it is not yet fully clear
where in the vehicle they were sitting, so I have requested a follow-up statement from counsel.
2025-03-04
Medical records indicate a whiplash-type injury. The reported injury fits well with the kind and force of this crash, and
no earlier injury to the same body area is known. Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient
improved.
2025-04-17
The claimant's statement was taken through counsel. They added a few small details since the first account, but the
core account of the lane change and contact has stayed the same arcoss every telling.
2025-05-23
Based on the photos, the vehicle damage, the medical course, and the consistent account, the file supports the claim
as presented. Pending receipt of the follow-up seating statement, I am recommending the claim proceed to
evaluation.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
